 [Anchor] 
 Here is news on newly released films. This week, movies such as 'Pressure', which depicts the events inside the Allied command surrounding weather forecasts during World War II, are drawing attention. 
 Reporter Lee Joo-hyoung has the story. 
 [Reporter] 
 [Pressure / Director: Anthony Maras / Starring: Andrew Scott, Brendan Fraser] 
 True to its title, the film 'Pressure' is a psychological drama that follows the pressure felt by two men. 
 One man is Eisenhower, Supreme Commander of the Allied Expeditionary Force in World War II, and the other is Stagg, the chief meteorologist for the Allies. 
 Just before the Normandy landings that stake the fate of the Allied forces, opinions clash inside the weather forecasting room over what the weather will be like on D-Day. 
 As to whether to go ahead or not, the atmospheric pressure also soars between the Allied commander and the military leadership. 
 --- 
 [De Gaulle: The Beginning of War / Director: Antonin Baudry / Starring: Simon Abkarian, Simon Russell Beale, Benoît Magimel] 
 'De Gaulle: The Beginning of War' and 'The Age of Freedom', released in Korea two weeks apart, are French historical blockbusters. 
 They shed light on the era of De Gaulle, such a representative leader of France that airports, squares, and aircraft carriers are named after him. 
 The two films cost a combined 150 billion won in production costs and attracted 6 million moviegoers locally. 
 --- 
 [Horumong / Director: Lee Il-ha / Starring: Shin Sook-ok] 
 'Horumong' is a documentary film starring Shin Sook-ok, a third-generation Korean resident in Japan well-known for her TV debate footage with the Japanese right wing. 
 [Lee Il-ha / Director: She was a legend. She used to appear on a lot of variety-style debates. She even had a war of words with Takeshi Kitano and was at the top tier.] 
 The film unfolds the harsh times that three generations of Shin Sook-ok's family had to endure in Japan, alongside the life story of how Shin transitioned from a corporate executive to a human rights activist. 
 [Shin Sook-ok / Human Rights Activist: I think I had no choice but to fight. If I wanted to live here as a Zainichi, with South Korean nationality, and as a third-generation Zainichi, I had to do so.] 
 --- 
 [Scrooge: A Christmas Carol / Director: Ti West / Starring: Johnny Depp, Ian McKellen, Rupert Grint] 
 'Scrooge: A Christmas Carol' is a film based on Charles Dickens' famous original work of the same name. 
 It depicts the events that unfold when the ghost of a dead business partner appears before Ebenezer Scrooge, the epitome of a miser, on Christmas Eve, with Johnny Depp taking on the lead role.
